Reference captures from figma.com home page at both viewports; color overlap confirmed >= 3 at both viewports (buckets: white/4095, black/0, light-gray/3822). assertions.evaluate: (() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['figma.com/logo', 'figma-logo', 'figma-wordmark', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
